SRC-032:R001.text: Add only the exact verified OpenCode built-in skill identity to the bounded adapter read fast-path so bootstrap works without Python or guard reachability.

SRC-032:R002.text: Do not grant skill trust by suffix or namespace; plugin.skill, mcp__x__skill, and every unknown or namespaced identity still enter the guard and fail closed when unreachable.

SRC-032:R003.text: Keep exact built-in repository reads usable without actor binding or guard reachability and retain a red-green regression for the exact skill gap.

SRC-032:R004.text: Provide one canonical production OpenCode launcher that requires an explicit trusted SAIPEN seat and creates SAIPEN_AGENT before OpenCode starts.

SRC-032:R005.text: The canonical launcher exports the resolved project root and portable lineage when present, and all supported OpenCode launch callers reuse this single environment builder.

SRC-032:R006.text: Never use OpenCode sessionID as actor, never inherit STATE.agent for an unbound host launch, and never turn ACTOR_UNBOUND into allow.

SRC-032:R007.text: Capture the launch actor once per OpenCode plugin factory so sequential calls retain one stable seat; independent launches and projects must not leak bindings.
